comment: Speaker mapping configuration for WhisperX transcripts. Edit this file to map Speaker IDs to player/character names.

global_mapping.comment: Global mappings apply to all sessions. Example: SPEAKER_01 is always Alice

session_mappings.comment: Session-specific overrides. Only applies to specified sessions.

filename_mapping.comment: Workflow A (Craig/Audacity): per-speaker filename token -> character name

notes: Fill in the mapping arrays with your actual player names. Speaker IDs come from WhisperX diarization output.
